metadata.stressDefinition: Mean of percentile ranks for (a) five-year monsoon departure (drier = higher), (b) pre-monsoon groundwater depth (deeper = higher), (c) non-irrigated share (less irrigated = higher).
metadata.stressNotice: Neerakshi Water Stress Index is a project-defined analytical composite, not an official government classification.
